name: amazing-marvin
description: Use every stable Amazing Marvin endpoint available to its limited API token.
long_description: Connect Claude Desktop to all nine stable Amazing Marvin endpoints available to the limited API token. One optional switch adds five tested experimental read tools.

api_token.title: Amazing Marvin limited API token
api_token.description: Paste API_TOKEN from Amazing features → Integrations → API

enable_beta_reads.title: Enable experimental features
enable_beta_reads.description: Expose account identity, direct children, time blocks, time-history, and kudos reads. Marvin does not label these endpoints stable.

tools.name: marvin_test_connection
tools.description: Verify the limited API token without reading task data.

tools.name: marvin_get_todays_tasks
tools.description: List scheduled tasks and projects for one date.

tools.name: marvin_get_due_tasks
tools.description: List open tasks and projects due by one date.

tools.name: marvin_get_categories
tools.description: List categories and projects with IDs and parent relationships.

tools.name: marvin_get_labels
tools.description: List labels with IDs and group information.

tools.name: marvin_get_goals
tools.description: List goals, optionally including notes and detailed sections.

tools.name: marvin_get_tracked_item
tools.description: Show the task currently being time-tracked.

tools.name: marvin_add_task
tools.description: Create one task with scheduling and organization fields.

tools.name: marvin_add_project
tools.description: Create one project/category with scheduling and organization fields.
